mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Tactiq?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk is the best Tactiq alternative if you want follow-up work done. Fathom wins if you want free unlimited recording, and Notta if you need cheap transcription minutes and file uploads. Fireflies suits CRM-driven teams, while Google Meet's built-in notes suit English-only Workspace teams.

Yes, with no credit card and no time limit: 10 transcripts and 5 AI credits a month. Two useful details from Tactiq's FAQ: 1 credit equals 1 AI action, and when you run out, transcription carries on while AI pauses until the reset. Pro at $8 lifts the transcript cap.

Tactiq lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA compliance, and says OpenAI does not train on data sent through its enterprise API. Only you see the live transcript, though you can notify the room. Review the extension permissions with IT before a company-wide install.

Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Notta, Read AI, Google Meet's built-in notes and Lynkk. Entry prices cluster tightly: $8 Tactiq Pro, $8.17 Notta Pro, $8.33 Otter Pro, $10 Fireflies Pro, all billed yearly. The real split is capture method and what happens after the call.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Tactiq alternative for Zoom and Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lynkk, Fathom, Fireflies, Otter and Read AI all cover Zoom and Microsoft Teams as well as Google Meet. One operational difference: a bot joins from your calendar and needs admitting on some platforms, while Tactiq never appears in the participant list because it reads captions locally.

mainEntity.name: Does any Tactiq alternative support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lynkk covers Hindi and adds a Hinglish setting, with Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali in beta. Google Meet's Take notes for me lists 8 languages, none of them Hindi, and needs the meeting spoken in the chosen one.
